source: Google Street View metadata (free), by panorama id; for a gone one, by location within 25 m of its camera (outdoor)
same_image_rule: same capture month, <= 5 m from the old camera, and the production detector re-run on the replacement photo (same heading, pitch and field of view) finds the saved boxes again: median IoU >= 0.8, >= 80% of the saved boxes with confidence >= 0.5 found at IoU >= 0.5, no shift over 6 px; at least 2 such boxes to judge

same_image_restore.rule: >= 90% of the judged retired panoramas must pass, else none is restored
